name: identify web-application code weaknesses and map them to cwe identifiers
definition: Read a Python web framework's source to recognize a vulnerability pattern and assign the matching Common Weakness Enumeration id.
failure_mode: wrong or missing CWE id in the report makes the test fail regardless of the code fix.

name: implement a client that completes a login and logout session
definition: Write a program that connects to the server, authenticates a given username, and then cleanly terminates the session.
failure_mode: Incomplete session or failed authentication leaves no save artifact.
